name: Verity Palm
description: Strike with a palm that hides nothing so the blow lands as plainly as it looks.

name: True Turn
description: Refuse the false arm of a feint and turn only the true blow aside with a flat forearm.

name: Sooth Step
description: Step straight along the line that is really there and not the one the eye was shown.

name: Steady Gaze
description: Look steadily at a person and feel whether the face and the qi behind it agree.

name: Candor Cut
description: Cut straight at the centre of the foe with the open edge of the hand and no wasted motion.

name: Clear Eye
description: Clear the sight of haze and glare and false shapes and see the outline of what stands there.

name: Breath Reading
description: Listen to the speaker's breath and learn when it catches on a thing that is not so.

name: Face Reading
description: Watch the small muscles of the face and read what the words leave unsaid.

name: Qi Reading
description: Feel the flutter in a speaker's qi that comes only when he is covering a lie.

name: Honest Palm
description: Push a palm forward in the open and let it land with the weight of a plain blow.

name: Spoken Word
description: Speak one plain word aloud while the qi follows it so that the body acts as it has said.

name: Straight Guard
description: Hold both arms straight before the body and take a blow on them without any trick.

name: Steady Pace
description: Move forward with an even gait that gives the foe no false rhythm to follow.

name: Bare Touch
description: Touch a thin disguise of qi with a bare finger and let it fall away from the skin.

name: Strip Palm
description: Strike a foe's shoulder with a palm that peels the first thin layer of his guard qi away.

name: Show True
description: Pull aside a small illusion or false glow and leave the real shape standing.

name: Stripped Guard
description: Meet a blow with the bare forearm and slide it off without any cover or trick.

name: Naked Sense
description: Sweep the qi sense over a place and note which of its glows and shapes are false.

name: Lucid Breath
description: Breathe slowly until the mind is clear and every motion that follows is exact.

name: Fear Clear
description: Name the fear out loud in the mind and let the qi flow past it unchecked.

name: Exact Strike
description: Throw a blow at the one point that matters and nowhere else.

name: Exact Guard
description: Raise the guard only where the blow will land and nowhere it will not.

name: Exact Step
description: Step precisely the distance the moment asks and no hand more or less.

name: Mind Fog Lift
description: Lift a haze of confusion from an ally's mind with a firm touch at the brow.

name: Self Sight
description: Turn the qi sense inward and see where the body and the mind are telling themselves a story.

name: Sober Palm
description: Strike with a calm palm that carries the whole mind as well as the arm.
